This build is a community fork adapted to run Android (AOSP). Before you continue, please read where this app comes from and what it does.


Source

This fork: GStore, maintained by KangRio
Upstream: Aurora Store, by whyorean (AuroraOSS)
License: GPLv3, free and open source software

• This fork on GitHub
• Original Aurora Store
• Official site


This Build

Packaged and signed independently for AOSP, with rootless microG/GmsCore patching so apps run without root access. See the README for build-specific notes and known limitations on this platform.


Support

If you find this build useful, you can support its development and help keep the project alive.
